## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
install.packages("MCMCglmm")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(MCMCglmm)
```

## Read the individual data file

```{r}
individual_data <- read.csv2("/Users/fex004/Documents/GitHub/DelaFuente2021/original_paper/IndividualData.csv")

individual_data
```

## Clean the dataset by extracting the variables needed for simulation H1b (Node degree)

```{r}
clean_data <- individual_data %>%
  select(Condition, Session, Group, Individual, Sex, Age, Animals_shared)

clean_data
```

## run original GLMM

```{r}
prior <- list(
  G = list(
    G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
    G2 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002)
  )
)

set.seed(123)

node_degree_origin <- MCMCglmm(
  Animals_shared ~ Age + Sex * Condition,
  random = ~ Group + Session,
  family = "poisson",
  data = clean_data,
  prior = prior,
  nitt = 230000,
  burnin = 30000,
  thin = 200,
  verbose = FALSE
)

summary(node_degree_origin)
```
